question: As per Article 51A of the Constitution of India, Fundamental Duty (h) is to develop the ______________, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
solution:
The correct answer is __**scientific temper**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 51A(h)** of the Constitution of India lists the fundamental duty to develop the scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
 
• The concept of **scientific temper** was promoted by the first Prime Minister of India, Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• Scientific temper refers to an **attitude of logical and rational thinking**.
 
• This duty aims to encourage **critical thinking and scientific reasoning** among citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental Duties**

 
 
• Fundamental Duties are moral obligations of all citizens to help promote a spirit of patriotism and to uphold the unity of India.
 
• These duties are listed in **Part IV-A** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Initially, there were ten Fundamental Duties, but an eleventh duty was added by the **86th Amendment Act** in 2002.
 
 
 
• **Scientific Temper**
 
 
• Scientific temper is a way of life that involves the application of logic and the avoidance of superstition and irrational beliefs.
 
• It is essential for the progress and development of society.
 
• Promoting scientific temper is also crucial for fostering innovation and technological advancements.
 
 
 
• **Humanism**
 
 
• Humanism is a rational philosophy informed by science, inspired by art, and motivated by compassion.
 
• It affirms the dignity and worth of all people and promotes human welfare and happiness.
 
 
 
• **Spirit of Inquiry**
 
 
• The spirit of inquiry involves curiosity, questioning, and the search for truth and knowledge.
 
• It encourages people to challenge established norms and contribute to societal reforms.
